description.narrative: The initiative contributes to the strategic goal of protecting democratic space, and increasing the capacity of independent civil society groups. The accumulation of power within Venezuela's Executive Branch has negatively impacted basic human rights of Venezuelans. Sectors such as media and civil society that would normally serve as watchdogs against human-rights/political-rights violations are limited by financing, intimidation, regulations and legal constraints that impede free and legitimate operation.
